queries_run: Arrow Electronics third quarter 2026 results components global enterprise computing solutions sales
Arrow Electronics fourth quarter 2026 guidance end market demand outlook

findings.claim: Q3 2026 Global Components 銷售年增 43%、Global ECS 年增 29%；Components 需求廣泛、積壓訂單增加、book-to-bill 遠高於 1。
findings.source: Arrow Electronics Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K Ex.99.1)
findings.excerpt: Global Components continues to benefit from broad-based demand across geographies, customer segments and industry verticals, with a growing backlog and book-to-bill ratios well above parity.

findings.claim: Q4 2026 指引：Global Components 銷售 81.5–85.5 億美元、Global ECS 34.0–36.0 億美元，合併 115.5–121.5 億美元。
findings.source: Arrow Electronics Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K Ex.99.1)
findings.excerpt: Global Components sales of $8.15 billion to $8.55 billion

findings.claim: Q3 2026 區域 Components：美洲 +58%、EMEA +41%、亞太 +33%；ECS 美洲 +27%、EMEA +30%；營運現金流 -4.41 億美元（營運資金投入）。
findings.source: 搜尋摘要（Q3 2026 release 彙整）

end_markets.note: 未查到市佔、價格走向、TAM 共識的來源（本軸只下 2 次搜尋）；Q3 2026 營收段成長與 Q4 指引已有原文。
